body:
okay folklore track 3 will never not make me gasp 🍂

'the last great american dynasty' isn't a made-up story — it's the real history of rebekah harkness, the standard oil heiress who owned taylor's rhode island house (holiday house, in watch hill) decades before taylor ever did.

and then in the last verse taylor writes herself straight into the song: the woman the town called too loud, too much, too marvelous — and the new owner who gets called all the same things.

it's the most folklore thing on folklore — a whole history lesson smuggled inside a pop song, hiding in plain sight at track 3.

tag the friend who still swears track 3 is fiction, then take them all the way back into the era 👉 https://longlivets.com/?era=folklore&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=heartbeat
